event_summary.short: A white male suspect, later identified as Daniel, was arrested after a disturbance at a Lansing bus stop. He used racial slurs and assaulted a black male. During arrest, he attempted to grab an officer's firearm. He was charged with attempted disarming and resisting, and later pleaded no contest, receiving 221 days time served.
